name: Out-of-Core Rendering with Virtual Page Tables
definition: A strategy for managing large-scale data uploads using virtual page tables and on-demand brick transfers, where volumes are preprocessed, mipmapped, and bricked to be uploaded to GPU with dynamic requests.
summary: Out-of-core rendering with virtual page tables visualizes large volume datasets by decoupling logical access from physical memory via a virtual page table to load only visible bricks on demand.
